detail.longDescription: I tried to make a unique color generator with rgb value increments in a numeric-system like. Rough script: for(let r = 0; r <=255 ; r+=0) { r = Math.min(r+178,255) for(let g = 0; g <=255 ; g+=0) { g = Math.min(g+178,255) for(let b = 0; b <=255 ; b+=0) { b = Math.min(b+178,255) console.log(`r: ${r}, g: ${g}, b: ${b}`);}}} Although it doesn't work as it should, the goal is to output these strings until 255,255,255 - 0,0,0 - 0,0,90 - 0,0,180 - 0,0,255 - 0,90,0 - 0,90,90 - 0,90,180 - 0,90,255 - 0,180,0 - 0,180,90 - 0,180,180 - 0,180,255 - 0,255,0 - 0,255,90 - 0,255,180 - 0,255,255 - 90,0,0 - etc. You can see that if the increment spills out of 255, it becomes 255 always. I know it is "imprecise", but it is bothersome to make a "precise" one, a simpler solution is enough.
